name: find_people
title: Find People
description: Find people and live China factories on Airsup by name, identity, role, company, expertise, or other natural-language description. Use this when you want to contact someone but do not already have their person_id. Do not use this if an exact person_id is already known. Important: matches is a relevance-ranked search sample (capped by maximum_results), not a complete directory. When the user asks how many factories exist, or what the total factory count is, always answer with live_factories_total from this tool result — never invent a total from matches.length.

query.description: Natural-language description of the person, factory, or people to find, for example 'Konstantin Saifoulline', 'CNC shops in Dongguan', or 'how many factories'.

maximum_results.description: Maximum number of matching people/factories to return in matches. This caps the sample size only; it does not change live_factories_total.

person_id.description: Stable Airsup identifier for this person or factory endpoint.

name.description: Display name of the person or factory.

description.description: information explaining who this person or factory is and why they may match the query.

live_factories_total.description: Authoritative count of published live China factories on Airsup right now. Use this for any question about how many factories exist. Do not use matches.length as the factory total.

matches_note.description: Reminder that matches is a ranked search sample, not a complete listing.
